title: DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, July 30, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, July 30, 2018 Posted by admin on July 30th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include American Express (AXP) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +33 points.
Friday the Dow was down -76.01 (-0.30%) at 25,451.06.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.96%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Chevron (CVX) +1.63% ans Walgreens (WBA) +1.63%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Intel (INTC) -8.59% and Exxon Mobil (XOM) -2.75%.
Caterpillar (CAT) reported record second-quarter profits per share and said it would offset a sizable second-half profit hit from the tariffs by raising prices. Caterpillar also bumped up its full-year profit forecast to a range of $11 per share to $12 per share.
Walmart (WMT -0.11%) is working on potential subscription video streaming service, according to a WSJ report.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.857 per gallon.
